name: checkpoint-diya
brief: Standalone UNLIT traditional Diwali clay diya oil lamp, a save-point prop. Side view seen a little from above. SHAPE: a SHALLOW wide almond / leaf-shaped open clay dish (NOT a deep bowl, about 2.5 times wider than tall), low gently curved sides, small round flat foot, and the right end narrows and is PINCHED UP into a clear pointed spout lip like a teardrop tip. A thick twisted white cotton wick lies in the spout, its tip poking up and out of the spout, tip charred dark grey (unlit). COLOURS: warm terracotta orange-brown clay, two flat shading tones, a dark brown oil well inside the rim with one golden oil glint line. Painted side band: a bold clean row of 5 white dots alternating with marigold-yellow four-petal flower dots, and one thin white rim line; large readable motifs, not speckle noise. Thick deep aubergine outline. About 56 pixels wide and 22 pixels tall. No flame, fire, smoke, glow or sparks.
subject: prop
